Maya (CS): Heads-up: Zephyr Labs renewal in 4 weeks. Ask: shorten term to 9mo, keep current 18% discount, split invoices across US/EU, and require notarized wet signature for EU legal entity. Also want a dedicated 6-GPU pool.
Zoe (RevOps): Got it. Need to model prorated 9mo pricing. Mixed billing needs per-entity invoice lines.
Ethan (Finance): 18% on 9mo ok only with 50% upfront or CC fallback. Also need VAT IDs and wire vs card routing per region.
Rita (Legal): Wet-notarization in EU varies by country. I'll draft a notarization addendum and signature matrix. Ask customer for signer full names + ID docs.
Sam (Enablement): If dedicated, offer a 48-hour staging window for KV cache tests. I'll schedule two sessions: infra + app.
ComplianceBot: ATTACH: SOC2 summary v2025: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2.pdf
Maya (CS): Customer says EU will wire on receipt, US prefers Net30. They can provide VAT/Tax IDs this week.
Zoe (RevOps): I'll produce SOW v1 with two pricing options by EOD: (A) 9mo 18% w/50% upfront; (B) 9mo 12% monthly. Include provisioning freeze clause.
Ethan (Finance): Add notarization handling fee estimate €200 + courier. Check withholding language for EU wires.
Rita (Legal): Adding gross-up opt-in for withholding. Drafting signing matrix now.
Sam (Enablement): Once SOW is live, I'll send calendar invites for staging and enablement.
Maya (CS): Action items: Zoe SOW; Ethan confirm fees; Rita addendum + matrix; Sam schedule. I'll collect tax IDs and signer names.
Zoe (RevOps): Draft link when ready: https://redwood.example.com/drafts/1781234567-zephyr-sow-v1
Maya (CS): Thanks team — will update when I have signer info. :thumbsup:
